crime: Every evening in the lounge, one girl tied a scarf over her eyes, counted, and went seeking. She never stopped until every girl was found, and she always found {WITCH_NAME} first.
At eight o'clock she tied it on and said, "Hide properly tonight. I'll find you last. Wait for me."
Long ago, {WITCH_NAME}'s mother had shut her in a wardrobe and said, "Count to a hundred. I'll come and find you." She came back three days later. {WITCH_NAME} had never waited to be found since.

Hiding, she felt through her Magic the seeker go upstairs, away from her. She came out and followed her to the library. At ten past eight, between the shelves, she pulled the scarf tight round the seeker's neck until the girl was still.

At a quarter past eight she used the seeker's own phone to post that she had been found, then sat down among the girls already found in the lounge. At twenty to nine she thought of one girl still hiding, felt where she was, and posted the spot from the seeker's account as a find. In a cell, the girl crawled out from under the lower bunk, exactly where the post said, and came to answer it.

At twenty to ten, {WITCH_NAME} led the search upstairs and reached the library first. She slipped the phone back into the seeker's pocket before the others rounded the shelves. They found her holding the dead seeker, the scarf still round the girl's neck.
In the trial court, the prisoners ruled the seeker was alive and seeking at twenty to nine, while {WITCH_NAME} sat among them from a quarter past.
Another girl spoke. "I was under that bunk too, lying in front of her, behind the hanging blanket. Nobody could lift it and find her without finding me."
The court understood. Whoever made that find had never looked. She had felt where one girl was, and only that girl.
fields.epitaph: The seeker never left a girl unfound. She would have come for her last.
fields.epithet: The Child Still Counting in the Wardrobe
execution: From the execution stand rose a compass dial as wide as the trial court floor. She was strapped upright at its north mark, her chest level with the point of the needle.
The needle was released pointing away from her. It swung round the dial toward north, drove its point into her chest, and stopped.
It rested there, pointing at her. She hung still at the north mark.

magic.name: True North
magic.text: She thinks of anyone, and a pull in her chest tells her exactly where they are right now.
